newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia's BULOG moves to cut palm olein prices.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia's BULOG moves to cut palm olein prices.

text.p: Indonesia's state logistics agency BULOG launched on Tuesday market operations to reduce the price of palm olein, a BULOG spokesman said.
"Yes, we have begun market operations," he told Reuters. "We are selling at 1,300 rupiah per litre."
The spokesman said the move was to ensure palm olein prices remained under control during the Moslem Ramadan fasting month that begins this week and the ensuing Eid al-Fitr celebration.
He said the market operations would last until January 15, and would be relaunched in the first week of February.

Traders said the palm olein packed in plastic bags was being sold directly to consumers. They said BULOG's sale price was equivalent to 1,430 rupiah/kg, compared with the market price of 1,450-55 rupiah/kg in Jakarta.
"There has been some caution in the market," one said. "But success of the operations depends on how much olein BULOG has available to pump into the market."
